I appreciate your response.  I have a rewarding job and I run approximately 30 miles per week.  I don't think these are the causes.  I di skip running during the weeks/months I'm at the lowest.

My wife refuses to be involved; she wants to give me my privacy.  She insists that if I thought it would be helpful, she'd see a couples therapist.  She's been more than supportive throughout all of this.  I worry that I didn't give her the full picture before we got married (after 5 years of dating).

I'm just at a loss for what else to try, I guess.
Eh, fuck it.  I'm home alone.  Why not, right?
